mechanism: Fluoxetine inhibits platelet aggregation and chlorthalidone causes electrolyte depletion and hyponatremia risk, particularly hyponatremia exacerbated by SIADH from SSRIs.
action: Monitor serum sodium levels, especially during initial therapy or dose changes; counsel on bleeding precautions and signs of hyponatremia; consider alternative diuretic if hyponatremia develops.
